## FAQ

### How long until I start getting cited by AI engines?

Most businesses see citation lifts within 60 to 120 days after implementing the on-page tactics and the core off-site work. The slower-compounding tactics (Reddit, PR, research) pay off over 6 to 12 months. AI engines also update their training and live retrieval cycles on different cadences, so expect uneven gains by engine.

### Does Reddit really help with AI rankings?

Yes, more than most SEOs admit. Google AI Overviews now cite Reddit threads for many recommendation queries, and ChatGPT pulls from Reddit content via Bing's index. Participating genuinely in your niche subreddits gets your business mentioned in the threads AI engines are already citing.

### Do I need to be on every AI engine?

Focus on the engines your buyers actually use. For most B2C and local businesses in 2026, that means Google AI Overviews first, then ChatGPT and Perplexity. For B2B, ChatGPT and Perplexity carry more weight. Check your analytics referrers to see where AI traffic is already coming from.

### Are paid AI SEO services worth it?

If they execute the tactics on this list, yes. If they promise rankings without explaining how, no. The category is full of agencies repackaging traditional SEO with an AI label. Ask any prospective agency to show you their schema implementations, case study content, and AI tracking setup before you sign.

### Will AI search replace traditional SEO?

No, it sits on top of it. AI engines crawl, index, and weigh signals the same way classic search does, then add their own retrieval and synthesis layer. Strong traditional SEO is the floor. AI optimization is the ceiling. Both matter.

### How many cities can a single site handle?

There is no hard limit, but quality drops if content production cannot keep up. A 5-location business that does 5 location pages well outperforms a 50-location business with 50 thin pages every time. Scale into new cities only when you can support each one with real content and real local citations.

### Can I use a state-level page instead of city pages?

For service-area businesses serving a wide region, a regional page can complement (not replace) city pages. Build the regional hub plus 5 to 10 city pages for the cities that drive the most revenue. Skipping city pages entirely means giving up the local pack rankings for those cities.

### Do I need separate domains for each location?

No. One brand domain with location subfolders is the correct pattern in 2026. Separate domains per location dilute authority, fragment your link profile, and create a maintenance nightmare.

### How do I rank in cities where I do not have a physical office?

You cannot rank in the local pack without a verifiable presence in that city. For service-area businesses, list the city as a service area on GBP for the nearest verified location. For franchise or chain models, opening a real or virtual office that meets Google's verification requirements is the only durable path.

### How does multi-location SEO connect to AI search?

Each location is a distinct entity to AI engines. They cite based on location-specific schema, reviews, and citations, not on your corporate brand alone. Getting cited by ChatGPT and Google AI for 'best plumber in Tampa' requires a Tampa-specific entity footprint.

### How many links does a local business need to rank?

It depends on competition. For low-competition local niches, 20 to 50 relevant referring domains can be enough. For dense markets, expect to need 100 to 300 quality referring domains to compete with top-of-pack businesses.

### Are nofollow links still worth pursuing?

Yes. Google explicitly treats nofollow as a hint, not a directive, since 2019. Nofollow links from authoritative local sites still contribute to entity signal and AI citation confidence.

### How long until link building shows in rankings?

3 to 6 months for early movement, 12 to 18 months for the compounding effect to become obvious. Local link building is slow, which is precisely why so few competitors do it consistently, which is precisely why it works.

### Should I hire a link building agency?

Be cautious. The cheap end of the industry produces low-quality placements that often do more harm than good. Look for an agency that focuses on real outreach to real local sites, can show actual examples, and prices accordingly ($150 to $500 per link is the honest market range in 2026).

### Do directory citations count as backlinks?

Some do, most do not in any meaningful way. Most directory citations are nofollow or do not link at all. They help local entity confidence but they are not a substitute for editorial links from local publications.

### How many citations does a business need?

Quality beats quantity. 50 consistent, relevant citations beat 250 sloppy ones. Aim for full coverage of Tier 1 directories, the 5 to 10 most relevant industry directories, and a handful of local Tier 3 sources. Past that, returns diminish quickly.

### Do citations still help with backlinks?

Some do, most do not. Most directory citations are nofollow or do not link at all. They help local entity confidence, not link authority.

### What is the most important citation site?

Google Business Profile, then Apple Business Connect. After that, the most relevant industry directory in your niche. Skip any of those three and you are leaving rankings on the table that no other work will recover.

### How often should I audit my citations?

Once a year is the minimum. Quarterly is better. If you move offices, change your phone number, or rebrand, audit immediately. Stale NAP is the most common cause of unexplained local pack drops.

### Are old, low-quality directories worth claiming?

If they already list you with the wrong NAP, yes, claim and correct them. If they do not list you at all and they are low-traffic spam directories, skip them. The signal value is minimal and the time cost is real.

### How long does GBP optimization take to show results?

Most businesses see ranking lifts in 4 to 8 weeks after a full optimization pass, assuming consistent reviews and weekly posts. Some changes (correcting a wrong primary category, fixing NAP inconsistencies) can move rankings in 2 to 3 weeks.

### Can I rank in the local pack without a physical address?

Yes, as a service-area business. You list service areas instead of a public address, but you still need a verifiable address Google can confirm during setup. Service-area businesses can rank in the local pack within their stated service zones.

### Do GBP posts help with rankings?

Directly, modestly. Indirectly, significantly. Posts signal an active, maintained profile, which Google factors into ranking trust. They also let you target seasonal or service-specific keywords that your main listing might not.

### Should I respond to every review, even one-line positive ones?

Yes. Response rate and response recency are both ranking signals. Two sentences thanking the customer and reinforcing what they liked is plenty. Skip none.

### How does GBP fit with AI search optimization?

GBP is the master record AI engines read for local queries. A strong GBP feeds AI Overviews, voice assistants, and chat-based search recommendations.

### Is voice search still a thing in 2026?

Yes, and more than ever. The rise of AI assistants (ChatGPT Voice, Gemini Voice, Apple Intelligence, Alexa+) has pulled voice queries above 30 percent of mobile search volume in many categories. The shape changed: assistants now generate answers instead of reading snippets, but the user behavior is bigger than ever.

### What is the most important factor for voice search SEO?

For local businesses, it is the combination of a fully optimized Google Business Profile, LocalBusiness schema, and recent positive reviews. For non-local queries, it is winning the featured snippet by leading with a clear 40 to 60 word direct answer under a question-format heading.

### Does FAQ schema help with voice search?

Yes. FAQ schema gives voice assistants a labeled question and a clean answer they can read aloud. Pages with FAQ schema get cited in voice answers measurably more often than equivalent pages without it.

### How long should a voice search answer be?

40 to 60 words is the sweet spot. Long enough to fully answer the question, short enough for an assistant to read in one breath without sounding robotic.

### Should I optimize differently for Siri versus Google Assistant?

Cover the fundamentals once and you cover most engines. Siri pulls from Apple Maps and ChatGPT, so prioritize Apple Business Connect plus AI SEO basics. Google Gemini pulls from Google Business Profile and Google Search, so prioritize GBP and traditional SEO. Same schema, content, and review work serves both.

### Can I track AI search visibility for free?

Yes. Manual prompt sampling, Google Search Console AI Overview data, brand alerts, and analytics referrer filtering give you a workable picture at zero cost. Paid tools save time and scale the sampling, but they are not required to start.

### How often should I check AI search rankings?

Weekly for your priority query set, monthly for full trend reviews. AI answers shift more than classic search results, so daily checks add noise more than signal. Weekly cadence catches real movement without burning your team's time.

### Which AI engine should I prioritize tracking?

Start with whichever engine your buyers actually use. For most B2C local businesses in 2026, that is Google AI Overviews. For B2B and tech buyers, ChatGPT and Perplexity carry more weight. Check your analytics referrers to see where actual traffic is already coming from, then track the engines sending it.

### Are AI rank trackers accurate?

Reasonably, with caveats. Because AI answers are non-deterministic, every tracker uses sampling. Two tools may report slightly different citation rates for the same query. Pick one tool, stick with it for consistency, and treat the trend as the signal rather than the absolute number.

### Does tracking AI visibility change my SEO strategy?

It should. If you find competitors winning citations on your money queries, that points directly at content gaps, missing schema, or thin authority signals. The data feeds back into your AI SEO program, and the gap analysis usually reveals more practical work than a traditional audit does.

### Does schema markup actually help with AI search rankings?

Yes. Schema does not directly rank a page, but it dramatically increases citation rate inside AI-generated answers. Pages with FAQ, Article, and Organization schema get cited measurably more often than equivalent pages without them.

### Which schema type should I add first?

Start with Organization schema sitewide, then add Article schema to every blog and content page, then layer FAQ schema on service pages and key posts. Those three cover 80 percent of the citation opportunity.

### Is JSON-LD better than microdata or RDFa?

Yes. JSON-LD is the format Google and most AI engines prefer because it lives in a single script block and does not entangle with HTML. Microdata still works, but JSON-LD is cleaner to maintain and easier for automated tools to parse.

### Can I have too much schema on one page?

Yes. Stacking irrelevant or duplicated schema confuses parsers and can trigger Google penalties. Add only the types that match the page's actual content, and combine them into a single @graph block when possible.

### Does schema get my page cited by ChatGPT specifically?

Indirectly. ChatGPT uses Bing's index and web retrieval, and Bing reads schema. Schema also helps Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and Copilot, which crawl your site directly. Adding schema lifts citation rate across all of them, not just one engine.

### Is GEO the same as AEO?

No. AEO targets direct answers inside traditional search results, like featured snippets and voice answers. GEO targets citations inside AI-generated responses from chat-style engines. They share the same content fundamentals, but the surfaces are different.

### Does GEO replace SEO?

No. GEO sits on top of SEO. AI engines crawl, index, and weigh signals the same way classic search does. If your pages are not crawlable or fast, GEO will not save them.

### How long until GEO shows results?

Most businesses see citation lifts in 60 to 120 days after schema, content structure, and third-party mentions are in place. AI engines update their training and live retrieval signals on different cycles, so expect uneven gains by platform.

### Do I need a separate GEO agency?

Not necessarily, but you do need an SEO partner who treats AI surfaces as a first-class channel, not an afterthought. Look for a team that already implements schema, tracks AI Overviews, and publishes original content.

### Can a small local business compete on GEO?

Yes. Local intent queries often have very few authoritative sources. A small business with clean schema, a verified Google Business Profile, and real reviews can outrank national brands inside AI answers.

### Do I need a WordPress website to use WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce runs on WordPress as a plugin, so if you don’t already have a WordPress site, we’ll set that up for you as part of our service. This allows you to manage both your website and online store from one powerful, easy-to-use dashboard.

### Why do I need professionals to build my website?

Then, we focus on managing and optimizing your digital marketing so you can breathe a little easier because you’ve got enough on your plate. While we’re busy creating a user-friendly, high-performing WooCommerce experience for you and your customers, you can stay focused on growing your business and doing what you do best.

### What are the common mistakes people make when setting up a WooCommerce store themselves?

Many people dive into WooCommerce because it offers so much flexibility, but that freedom can lead to costly mistakes if you’re not careful. Some common issues we see include: Choosing the wrong hosting: WooCommerce is self-hosted, and poor hosting can slow down your site, hurt SEO, and frustrate users. Overloading with plugins: It’s easy to add too many plugins without realizing how they affect performance, security, and compatibility. Ignoring mobile optimization: WooCommerce themes aren’t always mobile-ready out of the box, and a clunky mobile experience kills conversions. We build WooCommerce stores with performance, user experience, and long-term growth in mind, so you don’t fall into these traps.

### What costs come with using WooCommerce?

While WooCommerce itself is free, you’ll likely pay for hosting, a domain name, premium themes or plugins, and any custom development or ongoing maintenance. When you meet with us, you’ll get a thorough explanation of what exactly you’ll have to pay for, so no surprise bills!

### Is WooCommerce better than Shopify?

To be honest, this answer depends on your business. With our years of experience, we’ve found that some businesses work better on WooCommerce while others on Shopify (or other website builders). While there’s no direct answer, here are some of the differences between the two to give you a general understanding: Feature/Category WooCommerce Shopify Platform Type Open-source (built on WordPress) Fully hosted on SaaS (software as a service) Ease of Use Flexible, but has a steeper learning curve User-friendly, beginner-focused Customization Highly customizable with full code access Limited to theme and app capabilities Cost Structure Free core, but you pay for hosting, themes, and plugins Monthly fee + paid apps & themes Control & Ownership Full control over your site and data Limited control Design Flexibility Fully customizable with custom themes or builders Good templates, but more design limitations SEO Capabilities Excellent (via WordPress) with fine-tuned control Strong out of the box, but limited by platform rules

### What is AI SEO?

AI SEO is the process of optimizing your website so that it can be easily understood, recorded, and surfaced by AI-driven search tools like ChatGPT, Google’s Search Generative Experience (SGE), Bing Copilot, and others.

### How is AI SEO different from traditional SEO?

While traditional SEO focuses on keyword optimization, backlinks, and rankings in the search engine results pages (SERPs), AI SEO emphasizes how search engines and AI tools interpret and present information. This includes optimizing for schema markup, entity relationships, natural question-and-answer formats, and topical depth. All of which help AI systems better summarize and recommend your content.

### Why should I optimize for Google SGE and ChatGPT?

Google SGE and ChatGPT are increasingly being used to deliver answers directly without users clicking on traditional links. If your content is not optimized for these tools, your business may be invisible in these AI-generated responses. AI SEO helps ensure your website becomes a trusted source for AI platforms to reference, increasing your exposure and traffic.

### Can AI really “read” and summarize my site content?

Yes. AI search engines and assistants use natural language processing (NLP) and large language models (LLMs) to understand your website’s structure, tone, and content. If your site is structured clearly and contains well-formatted, semantically rich content, it’s more likely to be referenced or summarized in AI outputs.

### What is structured data, and why does it matter for AI search?

Structured data (also known as schema markup) is a form of code that helps search engines and AI understand the context of your content. Things like services, locations, reviews, FAQs, and more. It’s essential for appearing in rich results and for helping AI systems accurately pull and display information from your site.

### How long does it take to see results from AI SEO?

Most businesses begin seeing improvements within 4 to 8 weeks. However, visibility in AI tools is very unpredictable and depends on multiple factors including the quality of your content, technical implementation, competition, and how often AI systems refresh their data. Our process includes regular audits and reports so you can track performance over time.

### What is Meta Leads Automation?

It’s an intelligent system that automatically follows up with leads generated from Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) ads through personalized email, SMS, and WhatsApp sequences.

### How does your Meta Leads Automation work?

Our system connects to your Meta advertising accounts, captures lead information in real-time, and immediately begins personalized follow-up sequences across multiple communication channels.

### Can I customize the follow-up messages and sequences?

Absolutely! You can customize message content, timing, channel preferences, and sequence logic to match your sales process and brand voice.

### Can the system adapt based on prospect behavior?

Yes, it tracks engagement with each message and adjusts subsequent communications based on how prospects interact with previous messages.

### How will I know which leads are engaging with the follow-up?

You’ll receive detailed reports showing which prospects engaged with which messages, allowing your sales team to focus on the most promising leads.

### Is this service suitable for small businesses?

Definitely. It’s designed to work for businesses of all sizes and can scale from handling a few leads per day to thousands per month.

### How does your WhatsApp Chatbot work?

Our AI uses natural language processing to understand customer messages, provide relevant responses, and guide them through your sales process 24/7 on WhatsApp.

### Can the chatbot be customized to match my brand voice?

Absolutely! You can customize the chatbot’s conversation style, responses, and sales approach to perfectly match your brand voice and business processes.

### Can the chatbot qualify leads and collect customer information?

Yes, it can identify high-potential prospects, ask qualifying questions, and collect contact details for your sales team to follow up.

### How will I know when a lead is qualified and ready for follow-up?

You’ll receive instant notifications when qualified leads are identified, along with all the information collected during the conversation.

### What kinds of questions can the WhatsApp chatbot answer?

The bot handles general questions like business hours, service details, pricing, appointment booking (if enabled), troubleshooting, and more. If it’s a complex request, the bot will connect you with one of our human team members.

### How do customers start chatting with my business on WhatsApp?

We’ll help you set up a unique WhatsApp Business link or QR code. When customers click or scan it, they’re instantly taken to your verified business chat – ready to engage with your chatbot or a live team member.

### What if the chatbot can’t answer a customer’s question?

No problem! The chatbot can be configured to transfer the chat to a live agent or let the customer leave a message. We’ll help you design smooth fallback responses to maintain a great user experience.

### Does it integrate with my existing systems?

Yep! We can connect your WhatsApp chatbot with CRMs, helpdesks, calendars, or booking tools. That means your bot can pull or push data automatically, reducing manual work for your team.

### How does your Automated Appointment Booking work?

Our system integrates with your calendar to show available slots, allows clients to select their preferred time, collects necessary information, and sends confirmations and reminders automatically.

### Can I customize the booking process for my business?

Yes! You can customize booking forms, available time slots, confirmation messages, and reminder schedules to match your specific business needs.

### Can clients book appointments through different channels?

Absolutely. The system works through your website, phone calls, or even text messages to provide maximum convenience for your clients.

### How will I be notified about new appointments?

You’ll receive instant notifications via email or text when new appointments are booked, and all appointments are automatically added to your calendar.

### Can I reschedule or cancel the appointment myself?

Of course! The system will allow you to reschedule or cancel within business rules (e.g., “no cancellation within 24 hours”) and it will automatically update the calendar and notify the business.

### What happens if the system shows no available slots?

If no slots are available, you’ll either be asked if you’d like to join a waitlist or be shown alternative slots (for example with a different provider or at a slightly later time). The business can also manually intervene if needed.

### Are there any fees or deposits required when booking?

(If applicable) Some businesses may require a deposit, pre-payment or credit-card hold at the time of booking. If so, these details will be clearly shown during the booking process.

### What is a Website Chatbot?

It’s an AI-powered assistant that lives on your website, engaging visitors, answering questions, and collecting lead information without human intervention.

### Can the chatbot be customized to match my brand?

Yes! Our team of developers can custom-build a chatbot that perfectly reflects your brand’s voice, tone, and visual identity. From personalized greetings and branded color schemes to tailored conversation flows and responses, we make sure your chatbot feels like a natural extension of your business.

### Can the chatbot qualify leads and collect contact information?

Absolutely! That’s one of its main jobs. , it can identify high-value prospects, ask qualifying questions, and collect contact details for your sales team to follow up.

### How will I know when someone has engaged with the chatbot?

You’ll receive email notifications with full conversation transcripts and can access detailed analytics in your dashboard.

### Can the chatbot escalate to a live human agent?

Yes! We can configure fallback or transfer logic so that when the chatbot doesn’t know the answer (or if the user requests it), it passes the conversation to a real person.

### Will the chatbot learn and improve over time?

Yes, it will – especially if we include analytics and feedback loops. Modern FAQ-bots use natural language understanding (NLU) and track unanswered questions so you can refine the chatbot’s knowledge base.

### How secure is the chatbot? Does it handle sensitive data?

Your chatbot will operate under industry-standard security practices. If it handles sensitive data (customer info, account details, etc.), we can make sure it complies with relevant privacy and data-security rules, and we can set restrictions on what the bot can access.

### How do we maintain and update the chatbot (add new FAQs, change wording, etc.)?

That’s what we’re here for! You’ll have access to a dashboard or content-management system where you (or we) can add/edit FAQs, update responses, view analytics on top questions, and monitor performance. Ongoing maintenance is recommended to keep the bot’s knowledge base fresh! 

### What is lead prequalification?

Lead prequalification is an automated process where leads are screened and evaluated using intelligent questions to determine their fit, intent, and likelihood to convert before passing them to your sales team.

### How does your system qualify leads?

Our AI engages leads via phone or web forms, asks customized questions about budget, timeline, and needs, and scores them based on your predefined criteria.

### Can I customize the qualification questions?

Yes! We work with you to build a tailored script that aligns with your ideal customer profile and business goals.

### How do I receive qualified leads?

You’ll get instant email or CRM updates with full details including voice transcriptions, responses, and more.

### Is this suitable for small businesses?

Yes! Whether you’re a solo entrepreneur or a growing team, our system scales with your needs and helps you maximize every lead.

### What is an AI phone answering service?

It’s an automated system that answers calls, understands caller intent, takes messages, and routes calls- all without a human receptionist.

### How does your AI phone receptionist work?

Our AI uses natural language processing to handle calls 24/7, greet callers, gather information, and send you detailed call summaries.

### Can the AI customize greetings for my business?

Yes! You can customize greetings and call scripts to match your brand’s tone and needs.

### Can the AI route calls to different departments or people?

Absolutely. Calls can be routed based on caller intent to guarantee they reach the right person or team.

### How will I receive messages and call summaries?

You get email summaries with full call transcriptions for easy reference and follow-up.

### How should a business interpret map-pack visibility across different neighborhoods?

Google Maps results are influenced by proximity radius, relevance, prominence, and the searcher’s exact location. In Clearwater, visibility can shift between Clearwater Beach, Downtown Clearwater, Countryside, Island Estates, and the mainland communities. We track rankings on a geographic grid rather than relying on one office search, then compare those results with Google Business Profile signals, landing-page relevance, review patterns, and competitor density.

### How do you separate useful SEO growth from vanity metrics?

Rankings and traffic are diagnostic metrics, not the final business outcome. For Clearwater campaigns, we connect high-intent search terms to qualified calls, forms, booked appointments, quoted jobs, sales, and lead value. Call tracking, CRM stages, landing-page conversion rates, and source attribution reveal whether visibility in Clearwater and Largo, Dunedin, Safety Harbor, and the wider Pinellas County market is producing profitable demand.

### How can a local company strengthen its visibility in AI Overviews and answer engines?

Generative engines look for consistent, corroborated information about the business entity. That includes a clear relationship between the brand, services, leadership, location, service area, credentials, reviews, structured data, and authoritative third-party mentions. Concise expert answers and original evidence help systems such as Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity understand when the company is relevant to Clearwater searches without forcing the city name into every sentence.

### Do review volume and review velocity affect more than customer trust?

Reviews are strongest when they arrive consistently and describe real services, outcomes, and customer experiences. A sudden burst of vague five-star reviews is less useful than steady review velocity with natural service language. For businesses in tourism, marine, healthcare, trades, restaurants, and home service businesses, detailed reviews can reinforce Google Business Profile relevance, improve conversion rates, and provide entity-rich evidence that search and AI systems can interpret.

### When do nearby city pages create keyword cannibalization?

Each page needs a distinct search purpose, not just a swapped place name. A Clearwater page should reflect the market structure, customer concerns, proof, and service coverage relevant to Clearwater, while pages for Largo, Dunedin, Safety Harbor, and the wider Pinellas County market need their own intent and evidence. Internal links, canonical signals, unique headings, conversion paths, and differentiated entity references help prevent cannibalization.

### Can seasonal population and buying cycles distort SEO reporting?

Yes. Clearwater demand is affected by tourism peaks, winter visitors, weather-driven demand, and quieter shoulder seasons. Reporting should separate branded and non-branded traffic, compare leads by service line, and annotate major seasonal events. That prevents a normal demand shift from being mistaken for an SEO failure and helps content, offers, and conversion paths align with the next high-value period.

### How long will it take for me to see my ranking results?

If you call a company that says they can get you to the number one position in under one month, then you should immediately hang up the phone. This is something that can’t be predicted. It can take anywhere from 2 – 6 months, or even a full year to see results.

### How does Meta decide who sees my ad?

Meta uses what it knows about people, including their interests, behavior, location, and what they interact with. Then, they match your ad with users who are most likely to care about it. We’ll define your target audience so that it reaches the right people who will most likely turn into customers, and Meta’s algorithm figures out the best way to deliver the ad within that group.

### Can I do Meta Ads management on my own?

Yes, but it takes time to learn. You’ll need to understand how to set up campaigns, target the right audience, create ads that work, test what’s performing, and track results. It’s easy to waste a lot of money or miss out on opportunities that a Meta Ads professional can catch to optimize your advertising.

### How much do Meta Ads cost? Is there a minimum budget?

There is no strict minimum budget to start Meta Ads. Meta recommends starting with at least $5 daily budget for around a week so that your ad can reach your target audience. With the right strategy, modest budgets can go further. When working with Gilmedia, we’ll optimize your daily spend so that we can drive the best results while keeping costs low for you!

### Are Meta Ads worth it?

If your target audience is on Facebook or Instagram (and most are), then yes! Meta Ads is a great way for you to get leads, sales, or brand awareness. But they only work well when set up and managed properly. Randomly boosting posts or guessing your audience usually doesn’t deliver much. That’s why we do a lot of research on what a strong campaign might look like for your industry. Instead of being impulsive about it, we take the time to get to know your audience and how best to deliver your message to them so you can save money in the long run.

### Are Meta platform ads managed separately, or is it under one campaign?

All Meta Ads are managed in one place called Meta Ads Manager. In this dashboard, you can manage and choose the platforms on which your ads are shown.

### What’s the difference between boosting a post and running an ad campaign?

Boosting is the quick and simple option; it pushes one post to more people. Running a campaign gives you way more control over who sees it, what your goal is (like sales or leads), how much you spend, and how it’s tracked.

### How do you test which ads are working best?

We run different versions of ads at the same time, changing things like the image, text, or audience, and compare the results. The ad that gets more clicks, leads, or sales stays running. The rest get paused or improved.

### What are common reasons for ad rejections?

Meta Ads may be rejected for several reasons, including: General policy violation: Meta has strict advertising policies, and ads that go against them will be rejected. Poor ad quality: Meta may reject or limit the reach of ads that don’t meet its quality standards. Landing page issues: Even if your ad looks fine, it can be rejected if the linked page has problems and errors. Targeting restrictions: Meta restricts how advertisers can target users in sensitive categories. For more information and details on why your ad might be getting rejected, take a look at Meta’s advertising policies.

### Which social media platform is best for my industry?

Different businesses do better on different platforms. For example, stores with lots of pictures might like Instagram, while professional services do well on LinkedIn. It’s about finding where your customers spend time. By contacting us, we can help you figure out where your audience is more plentiful. That way, we can target the right people and turn their interest into loyalty.

### Can I do social media marketing with no experience?

While it’s possible to get started on your own, effective social media marketing requires more than just posting. Things like strategy, consistency, and a deep understanding of algorithms and audience behavior are where things start to become more specialized. Working with us guarantees your brand avoids common pitfalls, makes the most of every post, and grows with purpose and results.

### Can I use the same content across all platforms?

Each platform is a little different. Yes, they have their similarities in some areas but it’s more impactful to change the type of content you post on different platforms. For example, short videos on TikTok, long videos on YouTube. Small things like that make the difference in capturing your audience.

### Is social media marketing worth it?

Yes! Social media marketing is worth it for most businesses. It allows you to connect directly with your target audience, build brand awareness, and foster customer loyalty, all in a cost-effective way. Our job is to find a strategic and sensible way to promote your products or services on your social media platforms so that you get the best deal. In general, social media offers great reach and engagement opportunities. While results may take time and consistent effort, social media marketing can drive website traffic, generate leads, and boost sales when done strategically. Plus, it provides valuable insights through analytics to help you refine your approach and maximize return on investment.

### How does social media marketing lead to sales?

Social media marketing builds awareness, trust, and engagement. When potential customers consistently see valuable content from your brand, they begin to recognize and trust you. This trust is what turns casual followers into loyal buyers. Social platforms also offer targeted advertising, allowing you to reach users based on location, interests, and behavior, bringing your products or services directly to those most likely to convert. Combined with strong links to your website or online store, social media becomes a direct funnel for traffic, leads, and ultimately, sales.

### What are the biggest mistakes businesses make on social media?

Many businesses struggle to get results because they: Post inconsistently or too infrequently, causing followers to lose interest. Share content that’s overly salesy or unengaging, which can turn audiences away. Ignore their audience’s feedback or fail to understand their needs, missing opportunities to build relationships. We focus on meaningful, regular engagement, which is key to social media success.

### Are there accessibility requirements or regulations I need to follow for my social media marketing?

Yes! You should make sure your posts are easy for everyone to understand and see. That means adding captions on videos and descriptions for pictures so people of all sorts of backgrounds can properly decode your content. We’re skilled in making content accessible to all audiences, so that you can reach a larger population.
